feat: start minimized to tray option (#6)

* feat: 新增「启动后最小化到托盘」选项

layers.message: fix(hook): own HHOOK lifetime; join on stop; no probe-driven restart
layers.body:
fix(hook): own HHOOK lifetime; join on stop; no probe-driven restart

From user perspective: recording no longer kills the keyboard hook.

Root cause: F24 probe always false-negative, so every capture start restarted the hook thread; the old thread exit did store_hook(null)+Unhook(load_hook()) and tore down the new thread's hook. Keys then leaked to the WebView.

- stop/restart join the thread before start
- exit path only unhooks its own handle; CAS-clear HOOK_PTR
- start returns early if thread already running
- probe is diagnostic only; never triggers restart
- no file logging inside LL cal
